_README: First execution of registered contrast CMT-0106 (H1 pooled modality effect: text-only conditions vs image-using conditions), under the reconstruction rule registered BEFORE computation at reports/verification/family-fdr-registration.md S 5.1.1 (run-it-now policy, PI ruling 2026-07-30).
method: per condition mean F1 across 3 runs; unweighted group means. CI: paired tile bootstrap, percentile. p: within-tile label permutation of the five conditions (each with its 3 runs), two-sided p = mean(|null| >= |observed|) (PI ruling D42)

permutation.method: within-tile label permutation of the five conditions (each carrying its runs), two-sided p = mean(|null| >= |observed|)

validation_gates.gate_b: vectorised scoring == lib aggregate_tile_metrics on 50 probes (1e-9)
